content:
alex: Anyone seeing the preload race when we switch compact-overlay shards? reproducer in /tmp/compact-race.log — fails during warmup on a subset of configs. cc @maria @tyler

maria: Yeah I hit that yesterday. Root cause looks like our loader expects header-first, but compact-overlay can stream header after chunks. Need a tiny shim to normalize to an index-first view.

tyler: Two options: make the core loader handle both (adds a lot of branching) or add a lightweight streaming adaptor that guarantees index-first semantics to the rest of the stack. I vote adaptor — simpler runtime paths.

sanjay: Adaptor is fine but watch warmup credits. If adaptor buffers to emit index, it could hold warmup threads and increase tail latency. Proposal: allow ephemeral prefetch of N bytes (configurable) so warmup can progress without blocking full download.

olivia: Maybe we should quantify mmap vs prefetch tradeoffs on cold VMs. mmap avoids copy but OOMs on low-RSS instances; prefetch costs bandwidth but yields steadier latency. Any numbers?

alex: Quick runs on my laptop/cloud tests: mmap-first cold start median ~45ms, 95th ~420ms (OOM and jitter); prefetch-first median ~110ms, 95th ~180ms. So prefetch trades higher median for much tighter tails.

maria: Hybrid fallback would work: try mmap (zero-copy) and if it fails/ooms or checksum mismatch, switch to prefetch. The adaptor can advertise an "index-first" capability via a header bit so loader code stays simple.

tyler: Draft config I sketched:

```yaml
loader:
  overlay_adaptor: enabled
  warmup:
    prefetch_bytes: 64KB
    credit: 3
    fallback: mmap_on_success
```

olivia: Also important: keep the public WeightSource/ChunkStream API stable. The adaptor should live in ingestion/transport layer and present the same ChunkStream interface to runtime. No changes to consumers.

sanjay: Telemetry requirements: warmup.latency_ms, warmup.fallback_count, mmap.fail_rate, adaptor.buffer_bytes. Start with a 1% canary and alert on >2x baseline for warmup.latency_ms in P95.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for eng-ml/overlay-adaptor v0.3 -> 1% :rocket: https://ci.redwood/1234

alex: I'll open a small RFC PR outlining the adaptor interface, hybrid fallback, and telemetry hooks. Plan: implement adaptor + hybrid fallback + 1% canary. If no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll ship.

maria: :thumbsup:
